gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Lofree's Download Center lists the Flow 2's VIA Configurator as separate per-layout files (ANSI US, ANSI US Mac, ISO DE/FR/UK/Nordic), or that Keychron's current LSA keycap sets fit the K7 Pro and K7 Max but exclude the original K7.
standout_why: I opened keebscout.com/guides/low-profile-mechanical-keyboards and mkbguide.com/blog/best-low-profile-mechanical-keyboards. mkbguide already has the core of this angle: Flow 2 has VIA, its Cloud-series switch compatibility is 'narrower than Gateron/Keychron low-profile', the NuPhy Air75 V3 'moved from the V2's QMK/VIA stack to NuPhyIO 2.0', and 'VIA, Launcher, NuPhyIO and Key Mapper are not interchangeable'. keebscout already says the K7 is hot-swap only on some variants and that low-profile sockets take low-profile switches only. Neither gives the Flow 2 per-layout VIA files, the Keychron keycap exclusion list, or the K7 Pro's Bluetooth-only spec line. Neither covers the 65% models beyond a one-line mention. The three cited RTINGS pages returned only navigation to my fetcher, so I could not compare against them. I did not open mkbguide's 65% page, keyboards.sh, buildyoursetup or keyboardrecs.
decides: It confirms the pick order and does not change it. Keychron's own spec line makes the K7 Pro Bluetooth-only, with hot-swap on the 'RGB Backlight Hot-Swappable Version only', so it stays the budget row rather than a top pick. The Lofree Flow 2 68 (the row we can link) has VIA listed by its maker, with one caveat for the page: pick the file matching your layout from Lofree's Download Center. The maker-sourced NuPhy Air65 V3 cells are missing (nuphy.com returned HTTP 429 on every try), so the angle cannot yet separate the Air65 V3 from the Flow 2 68 on maker documents.

findings.label: Remapping software and files the maker lists
findings.value: VIA Configurator listed under Flow 2, as six per-layout downloads: ANSI US, ANSI US Mac, ISO DE, ISO FR, ISO UK, ISO Nordic
findings.note: The page gives Dropbox folders per layout and no link to a configurator, setup steps, OS or browser requirements. The ISO Nordic link is identical to the ISO UK link on the page. No firmware files are listed for Flow 2.

findings.label: Maker's manual for the 68-key model
findings.value: A separate Flow 2 68 user manual PDF exists, alongside the 84 and 100 manuals
findings.note: The link was read on the Download Center and the PDF downloaded (3.1 MB), but its text could not be extracted in this session, so no spec is quoted from it.

findings.label: Lofree Key Mapper scope
findings.value: Lofree describes Key Mapper as 'for Flow Lite Series keyboards'; Flow 2 is listed under VIA instead
findings.note: So the Flow 2 68 and the Flow Lite boards use different remapping tools, per Lofree's own page.

findings.label: Connection modes as the maker states them

findings.note: Read from Keychron's product record through storecheck.py search on keychron.com. Keychron's K Max records by contrast read 'Connectivity: 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, wired'.

findings.value: keebscout: 'a low-profile socket takes low-profile switches only'; Keychron K7 'hot-swap available on the optical and select Gateron low-profile mechanical variants'; Lofree Flow 2 'finally adds 2.4GHz' and 'VIA compatibility'
findings.note: Rival statement, used for the standout comparison only. Its 65% picks are Royal Kludge F68, Keychron K7, GamaKay LK67, Lofree Touch, Roccat Vulcan II Mini and Cherry MX-LP 2.1; the Air65 V3 and Flow 2 68 are not picks.
